text: IMF chief praises Vietnam's focus on macroeconomic stability

IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva made the remarks during a bilateral meeting with the Vietnamese Government leader in Manila, the Philippines, on November 16 on the sidelines of the 49th ASEAN Summit and related summits, according to the Government News Portal.
Prime Minister Hung praised the IMF's role in safeguarding global financial and monetary stability and helping nations navigate economic volatility.
He urged the Fund to continue strengthening its surveillance, forecasting, and early warning functions so countries can proactively prevent and respond to economic and financial shocks.

Highlighting strong Vietnam-IMF cooperation, the Prime Minister acknowledged the Fund's practical policy analysis and recommendations, particularly findings from the recent IMF Article IV consultation mission to Vietnam, which provide valuable reference for policymaking.

Sharing Vietnam's development orientation, Prime Minister Hung stated that the country is entering a new phase requiring renewed thinking and growth models to improve economic quality, efficiency, and competitiveness.

Vietnam identifies science and technology, innovation, and digital transformation as key growth drivers, while prioritizing institutional refinement, human resource development, and higher labor productivity to achieve rapid and sustainable growth anchored in macroeconomic stability and financial system safety.
Congratulating Vietnam on its achievements, Ms. Georgieva described the country as a dynamic and successful economy with increasingly solid macroeconomic and financial fundamentals.

She expressed strong impression with Vietnam's high growth rate, attributing it to systematic, persistent, and comprehensive reforms that have attracted domestic and foreign investment and deepened international economic integration.

Ms. Georgieva emphasized that reinforcing strong economic fundamentals is crucial for enhancing resilience against unpredictable global headwinds, reaffirming the IMF's readiness to continue sharing expertise and supporting Vietnam in macroeconomic policy management.

Discussing new growth engines, Prime Minister Hung outlined Vietnam's strategy to develop artificial intelligence (AI) and expand its application across agriculture, smart manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics while managing emerging risks.

Welcoming this approach, the IMF chief commended Vietnam's deeper integration into the global AI value chain and pledged support to help the country harness AI opportunities while addressing impacts on growth, employment, and financial stability.
On this occasion, Prime Minister Hung invited Ms. Georgieva to attend events during APEC Year 2027 and the ASEAN Future Forum in March 2027, with Vietnam acting as their hosts.
Ms. Georgieva expressed her wish for the IMF to actively contribute to APEC 2027 through joint policy dialogues and voiced hope to revisit Vietnam ahead of the APEC 2027 Summit.
